features.title: All the Tools in One App

items.title: Lossless & AROUND
items.description: We support LOSSLESS audio and are developing the AROUND format to create an immersive experience — as if you are on stage with the artists.

items.title: AURA
items.description: AURA adds visual and narrative layers to music, turning a track into a story and an atmosphere.

items.title: HEXA
items.description: Music connected to places. Interactive audio maps enable entirely new listening scenarios.

items.title: ROYALITY
items.description: Royalties as assets: buy, sell, or earn from them. More transparent and fair than traditional crowdfunding.

items.title: KANBY
items.description: An artist self-management system based on Kanban principles. Fans can track progress, support with donations, and follow the creative process.

items.title: ROOMY
items.description: Synchronous listening rooms — share the moment even when you are far away.

items.title: Donations
items.description: Simple transfers via Stars. Even reacting to a track post in a messenger can become a donation.

items.title: Playlists
items.description: Editorial, user-generated, and algorithmic playlists. Pitching system via Stars, no external tools required. Playlist owners can earn a share of royalties based on quality, not volume.

items.title: BETTER
items.description: A collaboration system inspired by SoundBetter. Artists can invite collaborators and confirm participation before a track is published.

items.title: MERCH
items.description: Artists can launch merchandise in a few clicks. Products are automatically distributed to marketplaces through partners.

items.title: Plugins Store
items.description: Third-party teams can create interface extensions and mechanics for Bilbo, enabling rapid innovation.

moderation.title: Quality Control
moderation.description: Bilbo uses a hybrid moderation system combining manual review and collaboration confirmation.
items: Protection from fake uploads and bot manipulation

ai.title: Human-Centered Music
ai.description: Fully AI-generated tracks are not part of Bilbo.
items: The center of the system is the human artist

international.title: Built for International Scale
international.description: Bilbo already supports multiple languages, including full Arabic interface adaptation with right-to-left layout.

vision.title: Strategic Vision

items.name: NFT

items.name: Payments

team.title: Team & Support
team.write:
If you resonate with our approach — write to us.
We are open to dialogue.

items.name: Why messengers?
items.description:
Our goals:

1. Protect musicians' rights.

2. Make music listening truly convenient.

3. Leverage messenger ecosystems to create a new artist-audience interaction format.

items.name: How does Bilbo support musicians in the AI era?
items.description:
We start not with millions of tracks, but with quality musicians.

In the AI era, the musician of the future is not only a performer, but also an artist, actor, and manager, able to build their fan community.

We support them by providing attention, tools, and unique mechanics unavailable on other platforms.

Our architecture and API meet international standards, but the main focus remains personal interaction with artists.

We solve tasks quickly, transparently, and with care for creativity — aiming to become their IT superpower.

items.name: Do you ignore the impact of artificial intelligence?
items.description:
We are against AI music, but we use AI as a tool.

It helps automate routine tasks, improve analytics, and recommendations.

A user can simply write in a messenger:

"Pick 1.5 hours of calm acoustic guitar music for the evening" and the system will generate results.

Even sending a meme with Nicolas Cage can become a music selection — no problem.

items.name: Artist Promotion
items.description:
We call it the principle of “Flea and Dog”: the artist (the 'flea') can find a project (the 'dog') that needs music, and grow with it.

Now we aim to be that 'dog' for musicians inside messengers.

items.name: Monetization via “Jibbitz”
items.description:
Inspired by Crocs customization, we created a system of extra features purchasable with Stars.

Most of the revenue from these mechanics goes to the artists.

items.name: Licensing
items.description: If a listener likes a track, they can immediately purchase a license — or download it for free for non-commercial use, with the artist’s consent.

items.name: Subscriptions
items.description:
In the future, there will be a subscription system with fair royalty distribution:
the cost of a listener’s subscription will be divided only among artists they actually listened to.

join.title: Join

intro.title: Join Bilbo
intro.slogan: Become part of a new music ecosystem built inside messengers 🚀
intro.welcome: Bilbo is a new kind of music infrastructure embedded directly into communication platforms. We start with Telegram, expand to MAX, and continue growing across other ecosystems. Our goal is to create a space where music, personality, community, and technology work together.
intro.moderation: Bilbo is a curated environment. Every submission goes through manual moderation — we listen to each track, review the artist profile, and verify authorship. This keeps the catalog authentic and protects artists from fake uploads and automated content.

items.name: High-Quality Music
items.description:
We expect carefully produced tracks with strong composition, arrangement, and professional sound quality.

Your music should represent your own artistic voice.

items.name: Authenticity
items.description: Bilbo is built around the idea that the artist is more than just audio. Musicians here are creators, storytellers, and personalities who shape their own creative direction.

items.name: Visual Identity
items.description: Music today lives across multiple layers. We expect artists to present a clear visual identity — artwork, photos, and style that reflect the atmosphere of their music.

items.name: Audience & Community
items.description: Artists on Bilbo actively connect with listeners. Building a real community around your music — through social platforms and direct communication — is an important part of the ecosystem.

items.name: Story & Personality
items.description:
We are looking for artists who bring personality and narrative to their work.

Your music should represent not only sound, but also identity, vision, and artistic story.

items.name: Human Moderation
items.description:
AI can help with analytics and recommendations, but decisions on Bilbo are made by real people.

Every application is personally reviewed by the Bilbo team.

join.conditions: If you are an independent artist with original music, a strong creative identity, and a desire to build a real connection with listeners — submit your application. If your work fits the vision of Bilbo, we’ll help you grow your audience inside a cross-messenger music ecosystem.

hero.subtitle: Turn every fan action into a visual show. A 'Like' isn't just a number — it's an emotion that travels into chats.

section-1.title: Emotional Anchor
section-1.desc: We link the artist's visual code with their music. When a user hits 'Like', your custom character explodes right from under their thumb.
section-1.card-1-desc: Your TGS stickers are a digital souvenir. Fans find them in Bilbo, fall in love with the animation, and take it into their Telegram and MAX chats. This gives your music a visual life in the fan's world.
section-1.card-2-desc: Every sticker sent in a chat is a hidden entry point. One tap, and a new listener is already on your Bilbo profile.

section-2.title: How it works?
section-2.step-1-desc: Upload your TGS pack (animated stickers) created specifically for your release or brand.
section-2.step-2-desc: Choose triggers: which sticker flies out on a like, a donation, or a share.
section-2.step-3-desc: Listeners interact with the track, the screen 'explodes' with animation, creating a unique experience.
section-2.card-3-desc: Gift exclusive stickers only to 'Superfans' — those who bought your royalties or have listened to you for years.
section-2.card-4-desc: Place stickers directly inside the track. At the drop or a lyrical moment, the screen fills with effects, enhancing the musical perception.

footer.title: Want to launch your stickers?
footer.label: Direct Studio uploads are coming soon. For now, we can set up your pack manually — let's chat!
